asked.item: where to add VAT number myself
VAT number printed on future invoices
no Tax ID field in billing portal

verdict.reason: The help pages give the exact steps to add a VAT or tax ID yourself in the billing portal and say it then appears on future invoices.

steps.text: Go to Settings > Billing and click "View Billing Portal."
Open your billing information and update your company name and address.
Insert your VAT or tax ID directly in the Tax ID field.
Your VAT or tax ID then appears on future invoices.
If you do not see the Tax ID field in your billing portal, contact support in the in-app chat (orange button, bottom-right).
